subject: Re: Evaluation asset delivery, MAP & acceptance timeline
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@brightcart.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval dataset & prompt pack delivery — acceptance criteria and timeline
Attachments: BC-Data-Security-Checklist.pdf

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, BrightCart is ready to run a 3-week evaluation of Redwood’s inference platform. Before we start, procurement and our data team need: a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, a short list of acceptance tests (pass/fail), and clear usage constraints for any eval datasets and prompt packs you provide.

Key asks from our side:
- Timeline showing delivery, access window, and takedown (we need asset removal in our sandbox by 2026-11-30).
- Explicit usage limits: no outside distribution, model training prohibited, only inference in our sandbox environment.
- A short list of acceptance tests (latency SLOs, correctness checks for 50 sample prompts).
- Security checklist completed (attached) and any evidence of ephemeral sandbox controls.

Can you send a draft MAP and the access steps? Procurement would like a single doc we can attach to our MSA amendment.

Lydia
Data & Partnerships — BrightCart

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@brightcart.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval dataset & prompt pack delivery — acceptance criteria and timeline
Attachments: MAP-v1.pdf; access-instructions.txt

Lydia —

Appreciate the clear list. I attached a concise MAP (MAP-v1.pdf) that lines up milestones, owner, and exit criteria. Summary below — happy to iterate:

- Week 0 (Nov 3): Provision ephemeral sandbox + secure S3 access (Redwood infra team — Monica).
- Week 1 (Nov 6–12): Ingest sample eval dataset + prompt pack (BrightCart to confirm subset; Redwood to provide ingestion guide).
- Week 2 (Nov 13–19): Run acceptance test set (50 prompts) — latency and pass-rate measured; joint review at end of week.
- Week 3 (Nov 20–26): Optional repeat & final acceptance decision by BrightCart; asset takedown scheduled Nov 30.

Acceptance criteria (short):
1) 95th-pctl latency <= 220ms for 512-token inference under test harness.
2) Functional pass-rate >= 92% on the 50 prompt checklist.
3) No dataset exfiltration observed in sandbox logs (we’ll provide audit log snapshots).

Usage constraints (draft):
- Eval datasets and prompt packs are provided under ephemeral, limited-use license for the evaluation only.
- No model training, no redistribution, no embedding index persistence.
- Logs and audit artifacts shared for verification; raw dataset persists only until Nov 30 unless an extension is agreed.

I also attached access-instructions.txt with the steps your infra team will use to pull in data and the temporary IAM role details. Monica — can you confirm provisioning ETA? Naomi — can you attach the small promptpack README once final?

Next steps: Lydia, if these look good we’ll update MAP-v1 with any legal redlines and send the DocuSign link for the evaluation MPA addendum.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0146

From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@brightcart.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval dataset & prompt pack delivery — acceptance criteria and timeline
Attachments: redlines_BrightCart.docx; BC-Data-Security-Checklist.pdf

Ben / team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement and security reviewed MAP-v1 and have three items + the attached redlines:
1) Add an explicit clause: "No model weight updates, fine-tuning, or downstream model-sharing with third parties."
2) Require a documented audit window: we need daily audit log exports for the duration of the evaluation and a signed snapshot at the end of week 2.
3) Clarify retention: raw eval dataset must be destroyed (and certified) within 48 hours of takedown.

We've attached redlines_BrightCart.docx and an updated checklist. Also confirm: will Redwood disable external network egress from the sandbox except for our IPs? That is a hard requirement from security.

If you can accept these points we can sign the addendum quickly — procurement wants a DocuSign by EOD Friday (2026-11-06).

Thanks —
Lydia

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@brightcart.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval dataset & prompt pack delivery — acceptance criteria and timeline
Attachments: MAP-v1-redlined.pdf; final-access-instructions.txt; DocuSign:BRIGHT-4721.link

Lydia —

Thanks — we've reviewed your redlines and accepted the three bullets as firm MAP items. I've attached MAP-v1-redlined.pdf which merges your language (no training/sharing clause, 48-hour certified destruction) and calls out daily audit exports. Quick notes:
- Egress: We will enforce sandbox egress rules to BrightCart whitelisted IPs only; Monica to confirm firewall rule commit by EOD Mon (Nov 9).
- Audit cadence: Redwood will push daily audit logs to the shared GCS folder and produce a signed snapshot at end of week 2.
- Destruction: We will run certified destroy and provide the certificate within 48 hours of takedown.

Next steps (mutual action items):
- Nov 7: Monica to provision sandbox & attach IAM role (internal).
- Nov 8: Lydia to confirm the eval dataset subset (list of 200 sample files).
- Nov 9: Ingest complete; run smoke tests.
- Nov 13–19: Joint acceptance run with scheduled check-in Nov 16.
- Nov 30: Asset destruction window (certificate delivered by Dec 2).

I've also created the DocuSign envelope for the MPA addendum (link in attachment). Lydia, procurement can sign that to lock in the MAP. Naomi — will you upload the promptpack README to the shared drive and paste the link into the DocuSign envelope? Monica — once provisioning is done, please paste the provisioning AWS role ARN to the MAP doc and the shared instructions.

Looking forward — tight timeline but doable.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — RedwoodLabs Campus
